unknownReportTypeFallback.note: getAgendaPrefixForReportType_() has no explicit case for an unrecognized REPORT_SUFFIX and returns '11.' (the 6G prefix) via its `|| '11.'` fallback (Code.js:1449). MAILING_LISTS/DRAFTS_FOLDERS lookups fall back separately: LIST_NAME uses LIST_NAME_LOCK ('3GPP_TSG_SA_WG4') and DRAFTS_FOLDER uses 'Plenary' (Code.js ~647-648). These three fallbacks are independent of each other and do not compose into a coherent 'unknown type' profile -- an unrecognized report type would silently behave like a mix of 6G (for agenda filtering) and Plenary/Liaison (for drafts folder).

defaultReportConfig._note: getReportConfig_() output with empty DocumentProperties/ScriptProperties, i.e. a brand-new Doc that has never run 'Configure Meeting Settings'. These are the meeting-136/Montreal defaults identified as main-meeting-specific fallback values in SA4-ARCH-001 §4.

structuralAssumptions: TDoc numbering: default TDOC_ID_REGEX is '^S4-\\d{6}$' (Code.js:720,3842); normalizeTdoc_/extractTdocId_ independently hardcode the equivalent pattern rather than reading this config value (Code.js:5070,2712).

TDoc table row schema is fixed regardless of report type: TDoc / Title / Source / Contact / Agenda Item / Type-For / E-mail Discussion / Revisions / Minutes / Disposition / Status, in that order (Code.js ~5484-5496, duplicated at ~5548-5560).

buildSkeletonWithTdocTables() auto-appends 'Any other business' and 'Close of the session' sections at the end if the parsed agenda did not already contain a heading matching those title keywords (Code.js ~5584-5605), incrementing the last agenda number via incrementAgendaNumber_().

ensureReallocationTable_() computes its insertion point as `${agendaPrefix}1.3` and searches for headings starting with `${agendaPrefix}1.2` / `${agendaPrefix}1.4` / `${agendaPrefix}1.5` / `${agendaPrefix}2` (Code.js ~760-813) -- this only makes sense for report types that follow the X.1.x subsection convention (SWG types); for 6G the equivalent position is 11.0.3, built separately in the is6G branch.

AGENDA_SOURCE_DOC_ID default ('1qP--dusvUhNwwBtMEH4xVdxaP1c6L1hZ49geICoYV2s', Code.js:655,3976) is a single hardcoded template Google Doc shared by ALL report types; its 'X.1'/'X.Y'/'X.Z' placeholder sections are still substituted via copySectionContentWithReplacement_ for main meetings. UPDATED by SA4-PROD-008: 'X.2' is NO LONGER one of these template-substituted sections for any profile that reaches the iprSection branch (every profile except plenary-6g/is6G) -- see each profile's 'iprSection' field above; is6G's own nested 11.0.4 (main 6G plenary only) is the sole remaining X.2-shaped template-copy consumer.

generateReportTitle_() extracts the meeting label from TDOC_LIST_URL via the regex /SA4%23(\d+(?:-e)?)/i, expecting the 3GPP FTP filename convention 'TDoc_List_Meeting_SA4%23NNN[-e].xlsx'; a meeting number/name that does not fit '\d+(-e)?' falls back to 'SA4#{MEETING_ID}'.
EMAIL_START_DATE default '2026-08-21' (Code.js:721,1902,2013,2081) is a meeting-136-specific fallback, overridable per Doc via 'Configure Meeting Settings'.
